notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the model and reviewed_by stays null; no hardware was attached or run, and no human review or hardware test is claimed. The package implements the card's confirmed entry symbol sunblaze_envs.classic_control:ModifiableCartPoleEnv as the SunblazeCartPole-v0 environment. The fake backend is the package's own pure Python stand-in (fake.py), not the upstream simulator: package code never imports the read-only clone, and gym==0.10.8r1 with its pinned Box2D, cocos2d, numpy==1.14.2 and scipy==1.0.0 dependencies (setup.py:42-51) are not installed where the gate runs, so the card's mock_strategy preferred upstream-sim path was not run. The fake re-implements the legacy Gym reset/step and the 200-step TimeLimit; it uses placeholder failure thresholds and the randomized variants' -0.05 to 0.05 initial-state spread (classic_control.py:296-299) as a placeholder, because the base class calls Gym's reset (classic_control.py:52-56) and the clone states no failure thresholds for it. The fake was never compared with a real upstream run. The action-space limit (action.index 0 to 1) is the bridge-derived bound of the fake's Discrete(2); the upstream action space is inherited from Gym's CartPoleEnv (classic_control.py:3) and is not stated by the clone. The install block in driver.lock.json is the card's and was not run. The 200-step limit is reported through the legacy 4-tuple done flag, so the bridge marks it terminated rather than truncated. Only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests and no extension ids. Three kinds of warnings remain and are expected: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only configures the next reset and makes no native call); four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, action.index and seed in reset and seed); and two G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space and observation_space, which the bridge reads as instance data but the clone's AST cannot see because the class inherits them from gym's CartPoleEnv, the external base named in classic_control.py:30 (the clone does mention the names, so the gate reports a warning, not an error). There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Not covered: the other registered environments of the repository (the MountainCar, Pendulum and Acrobot classic-control variants at sunblaze_envs/__init__.py:28-83 and the MuJoCo/Roboschool variants at :87-127) and any rendering; the card's entry symbol is the deterministic CartPole only. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
